[[page 1]]
Annual Sustainability Report 2025 - Example Mobility Group

Scope 1 and scope 2 emissions fell by 18 percent compared with the 2021 baseline, mainly through renewable electricity contracts.
The circular economy programme recovered 2,400 tonnes of steel and aluminium from end-of-life parts.

[[page 2]]
Water withdrawal per vehicle produced decreased to 2.1 cubic metres.
